transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Honestly, what made me come in is... I feel like the warm part of me just shut off. I get off work, and I'll sit with my husband or try to watch my shows, and I know I should feel comfort, or even a little happy to just be home, but... there’s just nothing there right now.
Has this feeling of emptiness happened to you before in previous years, or is this the first time you have felt this way?

No, this is the first time. I've never felt like this before. I mean, I've had days where I'm just tired from work and don't feel like doing much, but this... this is different. It's just a complete blank.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your sleep patterns since you started feeling this way?

My appetite is about the same, I think. But my sleep... it's been really bad. Most nights, I get home from the late shift and I'm just completely exhausted. I'll lie down, but every time I start to actually drift off, I just jerk awake. It's like I think I hear the pallets shifting at work, or something falling. And even if I do finally manage to fall asleep, when I wake up, I just feel like I never really rested at all.
Do these thoughts or sounds from work that keep you awake feel like you are actually reliving a specific, upsetting event that happened to you?

Yeah, exactly. It's... out of nowhere, I’ll just see that pallet coming down again. Or I'll hear that loud crash right in my head. It happens when I'm trying to sleep, but also just during the day. Like, especially if a forklift beeps, or if somebody just drops something in the warehouse... I feel like I'm right back in that exact moment, and my stomach just completely turns.
